scope: Targeted causal location comparison, not novelty proof.

matches.hypothesis: Native query-language cross-attention computes a LayerNorm result but discards it before query self-attention. Its affine parameters therefore cannot learn language-conditioned query calibration. Reconnecting only the existing qla postnorm may remove residual common-mode/scale nuisance and restore a task-loss gradient path; this is a falsifiable implementation mechanism, not a promised accuracy improvement.

First8 trained and first4 released-initialization native backward batches compare connected versus detached affine parameters at identical forward values. matches.hypothesis: The native detached Boolean previous-mask cross-attention gate can hide GT target point mass from geometrically matched positive queries, preventing later refinement from reading excluded target evidence. A training-only continuous mask-probability attention prior could reopen the evidence/gradient path without added parameters or changing native inference.

matches.hypothesis: In native two-scene TRAIN batches, fine 3D attention may include nonexistent padded superpoints when a scene has fewer than the fixed512fine supports. Fine-source gathering loses the scene validity mask and spatial nearest-neighbor selection can treat padded coordinates as real. This could contaminate query confidence with batch-composition nuisance; diagnose actual native attention/support incidence before proposing a correction.
